Job Summary

• Monitor and coordinate tyreman daily activities to ensure work is performed in a technically correct, safe and efficient manner, conform with company's standard and policies.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

To monitor and control tyre operation, attain equipment target availability and provide service to satisfaction of all tyres and users.
All tyres and users are proven to be satisfied with the provided services.

Develop and manage tyre forecast replacement, matching and repair plan while ensuring tyre recording system is good maintained.
Tyre forecast replacement is well-managed and developed, tyre recording system is good maintained.

Responsible to conduct tyre preventive maintenance list; front tyre replacement schedule, rim replacement schedule; tyre condition check on the unit in daily check pressure activities.
All of the tyre-condition related processes are accurately conducted.

Control sub ordinates to do the unit breakdown job in safe and on time completion.
Unit breakdown jobs are completed in a safe and timely manner.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

High School Graduate of Engineering

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• 1 Year of Tyre Fitter Experiences in Mining Industries
• Has a good knowledge about Tyre Maintenance and Repair activities
• Has a good capability to perform Tyre Failure Analysis
• Good in managing tyre site reports
• Proactive safety attitude and demonstrate to sub ordinate
• Good analytical and leadership skill
• Fluent in English, both
spoken and written is an advantage

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 5.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior
